```{r}
rna_up <- read.delim2("./UP_RNA_with_ID.txt")
colnames(rna_up) <- c("ENSB", "GeneName")

# ATAC-seq 1.5kb
atac_matrix <- read.delim2("./ATAC_Merged_1.5Kb_GeneDrive.matrix", header = FALSE)
atac_matrix <- atac_matrix[2:nrow(atac_matrix),]  

# Extract counts matrix
matrix <- atac_matrix[, 7:ncol(atac_matrix)]   
matrix <- as.matrix(apply(matrix, 2, as.numeric)) 
rownames(matrix) <- apply(atac_matrix[, 1:4], 1, paste, collapse = "_")
rownames(matrix) <- gsub(" ", "", rownames(matrix))
rownames(matrix) <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(matrix), "_"), function(x) paste(x[1:4], collapse = "_")) 

coords <- atac_matrix[, 1:6]

names <- as.data.frame(rownames(matrix))

ENSBID <- as.data.frame(atac_matrix[,4])
colnames(ENSBID) <- "ENSBID"

# List of gene name and relative ENSL
gene_mapping <- read.delim2("./gene_mapping.txt", header = FALSE) 

ENSBID <- merge(ENSBID, gene_mapping, by.x = "ENSBID", by.y = "V1", all.x = TRUE)
ENSBID$ENSBID <- sub("_.*", "", ENSBID$ENSBID)
ENSBID <- merge(ENSBID, gene_mapping, by.x = "ENSBID", by.y = "V1", all.x = TRUE)
ENSBID <- ENSBID[,c(1,3)]
colnames(ENSBID) <- "ENSBID"

mat_scaled_Unique12m <- t(scale(t(matrix)))

dist_matrix <- dist(mat_scaled_Unique12m, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")
num_clusters <- 20
row_clusters <- cutree(hc, k = num_clusters)

data <- as.data.frame(row_clusters)
table(data[, 1])


```

# Heatmap

```{r}
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3), c("blue", "white", "red"))
hmapUnique12m <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled_Unique12m,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE, 
  row_split = row_clusters,  
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",  
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",  
  width = unit(100, "mm")
)

hmapUnique12m

heatmap1 <- data.frame(region = names(row_clusters), cluster = as.integer(row_clusters))

df <- heatmap1 %>%
  separate(region, into = c("chr", "start", "end", "geneName"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(geneName = gsub("_.*", "", geneName))
```

# Transcription factors binding sites

```{r}
library(motifTestR)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(MotifDb)
library(scuttle)
library(edgeR)

region <- read.table(file = "Keep_Filtered.txt", header = T)
head(region)
i <- 1:nrow(region)
region$name <- paste("gene", i, paste(region$chr, paste(region$start, region$end, sep = "-"), sep = ":"), sep = "_")
region <- region[!duplicated(region$name), ]
rownames(region) <- region$name

gr <- GRanges(seqnames = Rle(region$chr),
              ranges = paste(region$start, region$end, sep = "-"))
names(gr) <- rownames(region)

as.data.frame(gr)

ex_pfm <- MotifDb |>
  subset(organism == "Mmusculus") |>
  query("jaspar2022") |>
  as.list() 
names(ex_pfm) <- gsub(".+jaspar2022-(.+)-.+", "\\1", names(ex_pfm))

test <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, gr)


out <- getPwmMatches(ex_pfm, test, best_only = TRUE, break_ties = "all")
names(out) <- paste(names(out), seq(1, length(names(out))), sep = "_")

remove_zero <- function(obj) {
  n <- lapply(obj, function(x) length(rownames(as.data.frame(x))))
  n <- do.call(rbind, n)
  n <- n[n>0, ] 
  obj <- obj[names(n)]
  names(obj) <- sub("\\_.*", "", names(obj))
  return(obj)
}

match_tf <- remove_zero(out)
match_tf <- lapply(match_tf, function(x) as.data.frame(x))

save(match_tf, file = "Keep_list_tf.RData")

df <- do.call(rbind, match_tf)
df <- as.data.frame(df)
df$tf <- rownames(df)
df$tf <- sub("\\..*", "", df$tf)
write.table(df, file= "./Lista_Finale_tf_New.txt", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names = F)

allregions <- df

count <- table(df$tf)
count <- as.data.frame(count)
count <- count[order(count$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), ]
count_top30 <- head(count, 30)
count_top30$Var1 <- factor(count_top30$Var1, levels = rev(count_top30$Var1))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(count_top30, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey32") +
  coord_flip() +  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top30_List_All", x = "TF", y = "N. of targets")


rna_bulk <- read.delim("./EdgeR/Results.txt")
InterestGene <- filter(rna_bulk, (logFC >= 0 & logCPM_C26 >= 5))

Intersect_All <- InterestGene %>%
  filter(GeneName %in% allregions$tf)

merged_df <- merge(Intersect_All, count, by.x = "GeneName", by.y = "Var1", all.x = TRUE)

merged_df <- merged_df[order(merged_df$Freq, decreasing = TRUE), ]
merged_df_top30= head(merged_df, 12)
merged_df_top30$GeneName <- factor(merged_df_top30$GeneName, levels = rev(merged_df_top30$GeneName))


library(ggplot2)
frq_runk <- ggplot(merged_df_top30, aes(x = GeneName, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey32") +
  coord_flip() +  # Barre orizzontali
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  labs(title = "N° Target Runk", x = "TF", y = "N. of targets")

frq_runk

pdf("./Freq_runk.pdf")
frq_runk
dev.off()


fdr_runk=ggplot(merged_df_top30, aes(x = -log10(FDR), y = reorder(GeneName, -log10(FDR)))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "forestgreen") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  labs(title = "FDR Runk", x = "-10LogFDR", y = "TF")

fdr_runk

pdf("./FDR_runk.pdf")
fdr_runk
dev.off()
```
